lines.en: Is this your bag?
No, Grandma. It isn't my bag.
Then is it Dad's bag?
Yes, that's his bag. My bag is red.
lines.ko: 네, 그건 아빠 가방이에요. 제 가방은 빨간색이에요.

lines.en: Where are my glasses? I put them here.
lines.ko: 내 안경은 어디 있어요? 여기 두었는데요.

lines.en: I saw them on the table this morning.
Thank you. Are our keys there, too?
Nothing is there now. Dad took them earlier.
lines.ko: 지금은 아무것도 없어요. 아까 아빠가 가져갔어요.

lines.en: Then I will ask him. Something is always lost here!
lines.ko: 그럼 아빠에게 물어볼게요. 여기선 늘 뭔가 없어져요!

lines.en: Don't worry, Grandma. I will help you.
Excuse me, is there something in this box?
lines.ko: 실례지만, 이 상자 안에 뭔가 있어요?

lines.en: Yes, there are apples in it.
Good. Is there something in that box?
That box is empty. Nothing is in it.
I bought your apples last week. They were sweet.
Thank you. Our apples come from a farm.
My grandson likes them, too. I want ten.
lines.ko: 제 손주도 사과를 좋아해요. 열 개 주세요.

lines.en: Sure. Do you want something for your husband?
Yes, he will like these oranges.
lines.ko: 네, 남편은 이 오렌지를 좋아할 거예요.

lines.en: Great. I will put them in your bag.
